title: ROOM ON THE GUN KEYS
why: From the review of the four-gun belt, build 5. A gun in his hands always shows on a gun key as well (his v15.25 note), so when he dragged the rifle from key 1 to key 6 to make room, key 1 still showed the rifle, and the next gun he picked up found no free gun key and went to the backpack (GUN SLOTS FULL). A gun key that only repeats a gun one of his own keys shows now counts as free, after any truly empty gun key: the new gun takes it and the rifle stays on key 6.
now: A gun key that only repeats a gun on a later key takes the next gun picked up.
